props.author: KillaXBT
props.text:
I'll be working on a $BTC update video today covering this trade. It'll be posted on X.

I held my long from 62.6K for 2–3 months, and it was far from uncomfortable. I round tripped my PnL countless times, to the point where most would have closed and looked for another entry.

In the end, holding the trade was the smartest decision I made.
↳ Chart shows entry 62.6K (original long), continuation long 76.2K, add zone 71.4K, target 126K+. Reinforces structural bull thesis conviction post-Sep 15 entries/adds.
